candidate_relations.reason: CT localizes the primary cystic abscess to the right posterior perinephric space, with secondary involvement of the right psoas major and extension to the iliac fossa. The candidate therefore misstates the primary anatomy and omits the giant size and cirrhosis context.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Identifies a Klebsiella-associated psoas abscess rather than the giant perinephric abscess involving the psoas in decompensated cirrhosis.
